description: The line plot illustrates the maximum activation values across different layers for four distinct gating configurations: atten_output, ffn_output, atten_residual, and ffn_residual. The x-axis represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to 25 in increments of 5, while the y-axis shows the maximum activation value, scaled from 0 to 400. The atten_output (blue dashed line) and ffn_output (green dashed line) exhibit relatively low and stable activation values up to layer 15, after which both show a sharp increase, particularly the ffn_output, which surpasses the atten_output around layer 20. The atten_residual (orange dotted line) and ffn_residual (red solid line) remain consistently low until layer 15, then both rise steeply, with the ffn_residual showing a more pronounced increase, reaching nearly 400 by layer 25. This indicates that the ffn_residual configuration experiences the most significant massive activations and potential attention sink phenomena, especially in deeper layers, while the atten_output and ffn_output configurations show more controlled activation growth.
